facts.value: In the Business English Foundation course, students learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. A variety of exercises are designed to promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and to provide a basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic topics. The reading and writing component of the course will be assessed in a 90-minute written exam in the last week of the semester. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the exam.
